title: eludite.editor.code_actions output
description: The light bulb menu. From the UI thread this is the state right after the request was sent, usually `loading`; from another thread (an agent) the call waits up to 5 s for the answer.

path.description: The document the request was made in.

line.description: 1-based line the request was made at.

column.description: 1-based column the request was made at.

state.description: `loading`: waiting for the language server; `open`: the menu is open with `actions`; `none`: no actions here; `failed`: the request failed.

actions.description: The menu's actions in display order (at most 200). Apply one with eludite.editor.apply_code_action and its `index`.

parent.description: The `index` of the action this one is nested under (Visual Studio's submenu).

disabled.description: Why the action cannot be applied, when it cannot.
